data.gender_notes: Babur is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Babur means 'tiger' or 'conqueror'. It is a strong and powerful name that is associated with courage, strength, and victory. In Islamic tradition, Babur is also the name of the founder of the Mughal Empire in India. The name Babur carries the meaning “Tiger, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Babur usually hope their child will grow to embody tiger, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Babur belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tiger, Conqueror.”
